items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. The clothing and jewellery are also excluded as personal property taken from a vehicle away from the insured location (§§4.3(d), 4.3(f) and 4.5), so no amount is payable.
The private car is not insured property under §4.3(e), and vehicle and journey charges are expressly excluded under §§5.2.5 and 7.1.8(d). No amount is payable.
